rules.support_scope: SUPPORT may only address BUILD/RUN blockers, reliability regressions, or repeated manual toil.
rules.run_scope: RUN preserves minimum viable operation; feature expansion requires explicit promotion.
rules.asset_scope: ASSET preserves accumulated value without implying active development.
rules.idea_scope: New ideas are registered before work starts; capture does not imply commitment.
